source: Driver visibility and read-only safety limits

checks.reason: Requires a chosen app, expected bundle/provision/signature hashes and in-process validation; SSH-wide receipt absence is not proof of tampering.

fix.how: Validate this condition separately in an explicitly scoped, instrumented application or native test harness.
